After a short delay, teleports the targeted friendly hero to your location. If the targeted friendly hero takes player based damage during this time, the ability is interrupted. When cast, the teleport target's movement speed is increased. Upon teleporting, the increased movement speed buff are applied to both Keeper of the Light and the teleport target, and the latter also receives a Chakra Magic.

If alt-cast, teleports Keeper of the Light to the target Ally instead.

Ability Level increases with levels of Spirit Form.
If Keeper of the Light dies, the spell effect is interrupted.
You can disable help to prevent Keeper from casting this spell on you.
Can be cast through the minimap, choosing the nearest friendly hero.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light_bio: Upon a pale horse he rides, this spark of endless suns, this Keeper of the Light.  Ezalor long ago escaped the Fundamental plane, separating from the other ancient forces to which he was bound within the great Primordial harmony.  He is a power grown sentient in the dawn of the universe, and now rides forth in all planes at once, one step ahead of pursuing chaos, bearing his gift with him at the end of a radiant staff.  His majestic truth lies hidden beneath the outward appearance of a slightly doddering old man who barely stays in the saddle.  However, when faced with the challenge of chaos, or the forces of darkness, his primordial light bursts forth, and his full power is revealed, transforming him once again into a force to be reckoned with.

*# {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*#* The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
*# {{Symbol|bonus hprestore}} {{A|Keeper of the Light|Spirit Form}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*#* Applies the [[heal]] corresponding to the spell damage applied ([[after reductions]]), and is roughly defined as:
*#** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|ΣHeal {{=}} [[Spell Damage|SplDmg]] x f(Heal)}}
*#* Does not heal the following allied units:
*#** {{M|Couriers}}
*#** {{M|Hidden}} units.
*#** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
*#** {{M|Ward-type units}}.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_keeper_of_the_light
data.bio_loc: Upon a pale horse he rides, this spark of endless suns, this Keeper of the Light.  Ezalor long ago escaped the Fundamental plane, separating from the other ancient forces to which he was bound within the great Primordial harmony.  He is a power grown sentient in the dawn of the universe, and now rides forth in all planes at once, one step ahead of pursuing chaos, bearing his gift with him at the end of a radiant staff.  His majestic truth lies hidden beneath the outward appearance of a slightly doddering old man who barely stays in the saddle.  However, when faced with the challenge of chaos, or the forces of darkness, his primordial light bursts forth, and his full power is revealed, transforming him once again into a force to be reckoned with.
data.hype_loc: Keeper of the Light is a helpful addition to any team. Manipulating the mana of both his allies and enemies, he effortlessly destroys lesser foes with waves of illumination, then enters his spirit form to gather his team to press the assault.

abilities.lore_loc: Ezalor's hidden light reveals itself in marvelous fashion.
notes_loc: Gives increasing vision over the channeling time.

abilities.lore_loc: The Primordial light turns the tides of battle in favor of Ezalor and his allies.
notes_loc: Upon landing, units will destroy trees in a 150 radius.

abilities.lore_loc: In the same vein, Ezalor bestows his harmony among others.
notes_loc: Chakra Magic does not reduce the cooldown of Ultimate abilities.
